content.text: Building a digital store that accepts crypto payments without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms is a pressing concern for creators in countries like Nigeria, where financial isolation and currency collapse can make traditional payment processors unreliable. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-works-10|COREMERCH guide to deploying]]-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-works-11|deploying]] a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, leveraging the power of open-source infrastructure to create a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-8|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce stack that puts you in control. By following these steps, you'll be able to host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and accept crypto payments through NOWPayments, without relying on Stripe or other restricted platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The problem with traditional payment processors like Stripe is that they can shut down your account at any time, freezing your funds and disrupting your business. This is especially true in countries where financial isolation and currency collapse can make it difficult to access these services. By using open-source infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a sovereign commerce stack that puts you in control of your payments and your business. This means that you can accept crypto payments directly from your customers, without relying on a third-party processor that can shut you down at any time.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you'll need to set up a few key components. First, you'll need to create an account on Cloudflare Pages and set up a new project. Next, you'll need to install the NOWPayments integration on your Cloudflare Pages site, and configure your payment settings to accept crypto payments. Finally, you'll need to set up a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to store your order data. Once you have these components set up, you'll be ready to deploy your digital store and start accepting crypto payments.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With your Cloudflare Pages site set up and your NOWPayments integration configured, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This will involve configuring your payment settings to accept crypto payments, and setting up a delivery solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to deliver your digital products to your customers. You'll also need to configure your Supabase or Google Sheets storage solution to store your order data and track your sales. By following these steps, you'll be able to set up a seamless payment and delivery pipeline that lets you focus on growing your business.
You can accept crypto payments directly from your customers with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This will involve deploying your Cloudflare Pages site and testing your payment and delivery pipeline to make sure everything is working as expected. Once you've completed these steps, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start earning revenue from your digital store. Once your digital store is up and running, it's time to focus on scaling your business. This will involve monitoring your performance and identifying areas where you can optimize your infrastructure to improve efficiency and reduce costs. By following these steps, you'll be able to scale your business and take it to the next level, with a sovereign commerce stack that puts you in control of your payments and your business.
